label: Besom
description: Two besom (jetted) lower pockets with double-piped lips and no welt, giving a flat, refined opening at the waist. The cleaner double-welt finish reads dressier than a single welt and is favored on formal and evening waistcoats. It keeps the lower front sleek and tailored.
